summary: The table copy menu button draws its caret as a centred SVG chevron instead of a fallback-font glyph that sat low.

reactNativeIos.reason: The phone has no table copy controls.

nativeAndroid.reason: The phone has no table copy controls.

updateRelease.reason: Ships with the next desktop release.

automated: npm run typecheck and the pre-commit test suite.
hardware: Rendered the old and new button side by side in Electron offscreen at 3x, dark theme; the chevron is vertically centred against Copy.
notExercised: Light and translucent themes were not rendered; the chevron uses currentColor, so it follows the same text colour as before.
